_why: One copy of the sentences the server answers for a CLI found and not used (system_cli_check.go cliRefusedNote and cliRefusedNoteTunneled, system_bounds.go's reasons and workingFolderReason) and of what the page reads out of each (static/cli_refused_words.js refusedWords, and the line cli_missing_list.js draws). The Go test builds each 'go' entry and must get 'note' exactly; the page test must get 'expect' and 'line'. A wording change on either side fails one of them (#12364).

cases.name: an agent's working folder
cases.note: Found but not used: ~/.local/bin/agy is in an agent's working folder: the agent "Security Reviewer" works in ~. Archive that agent (an asleep one counts too) or restart it in a project folder, then check again, so a launch refuses it. Install it somewhere else, or set its path in Settings > CLI paths (the setting cli_path_agy).
cases.line: Not used: ~/.local/bin/agy is inside Security Reviewer's working folder (~).
